name: Job Description Analyzer
description: Deconstructs a job description into must-have vs. nice-to-have requirements, hidden culture signals, red flags, and the skills the user should emphasize in their application. Produces a structured analysis that helps the user decide whether to apply and how to tailor their materials. Use when the user wants to analyze a job posting, understand what a job description really means, identify red flags in a listing, or determine which skills to highlight. Do NOT use for ATS keyword optimization (use ats-resume-optimizer), resume writing (use resume-bullet-writer), or company research (use company-research-guide).
